meta.title: Zoom Safari
meta.instructions: A tiny crop of an animal zooms out. Tap who it is before the whole picture shows: early guesses score more. Ten rounds; two wrong guesses end the safari.

art.style: Flat, friendly animal portraits on soft single-colour backgrounds.
